_comment: Floors gate on TESTABLE coverage — denominator excludes UI/lifecycle files per scripts/coverage-exclude.json. RE-BASELINED 2026-09-02 to the first measurement this gate has ever produced. The previous per-module numbers were carried over unchanged from the pre-testable metric (see git history) and so gated on a denominator they were never computed against; the leg itself never ran, so none had ever been checked. Each floor is the measured value minus 2 points, which absorbs run-to-run variation while still catching a real drop. Ratchet upward as real unit-testable coverage grows; do NOT raise the number by adding more paths to the exclude list. A module in `modules` that cannot be found in the coverage data FAILS the gate — record a deliberate exemption in `unmeasured` with the reason instead, so an extracted module is loud rather than silent.
_comment_packages: Package floors are the first measurement (unit-testing run 37333831409, 2026-10-05), rounded down to 4 places, with no slack. `packages` is package source measured by the app suite on the iOS simulator; `host_packages` is the same source measured by the package's own `swift test` on macOS. The two use different instrumentation and are never combined. TPPBookRegistry left `unmeasured` once its source (now in PalaceBookRegistry) was collected; its floor is that run's value, under `package_modules`, which is compared only when the run collected package source (CI does; a local Xcode run does not).
